452193.findings: Five painted chalkware/plaster character wall heads (pirate with eye patch, turbaned figures, Arab in keffiyeh) mounted on black felt in a gilt frame. 452193.condition: Paint looks good from the front, no obvious chips visible; frame gilt with minor wear.
452193.reason: Probably Bossons heads (title misspelt 'Boston'); collectable maker, five heads framed.
